findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed there is an accumulation of dust in the following locations: (1) walk-in cooler fans; and (2) ceiling vent above the storage shelves between the double door cooler and oven in the kitchen. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Ensure that the fans and vent are cleaned to sight and touch by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.comment:
Foods are not cooled using time and temperature criteria. Vacuum sealed bags that are not opened are placed on sheet pans after lunch and placed on a counter to cool. (10 minutes according to manager) The sheet trays of bags are then placed into the freezer. The manager states that they have been doing this for 7 years. The facility does not have a plan in place to cool vacuum sealed bags. Inspector has reached out to her food program director. The department will look into this process further. Until such time please follow the cooling SOP for the facility.

3-501.15: (A) Cooling shall be accomplished with time and temperature criteria by using following methods: FOOD in shallow pans, Separating FOOD into small portions, using rapid cooling EQUIPMENT, stirring food in container placed in ice bath, containers facilitating heat transfer, adding ice, other effective methods. P (B) When placed in cooling or cold holding EQUIPMENT, FOOD containers shall be: arranged to maximize heat transfer through container walls, loosely covered or uncovered, and during cooling period. findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
The facility uses cardboard boxes to hold bagged bread sticks and buns. Cardboard is not a smooth or cleanable surface. Use cleanable containers to store food. 

4-101.19: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material.
